content: Ŋeer ee, eeza Yona. I Amitai naatu. Saawe ee, Yoova aliiŋa ila pani ighe:
ve uvotia aliŋag pazi. Usaav pazi ughe: Ŋgar toozi sasaghati, yau Yoova naghit zi isov. Tauvene yau aat naghur atuya pazi pa sosor toozi.”

Eemon Yona itaaru, ve loolo pa ila Ninive mako. Tauvene ighe iyooŋ pa Yoova ve ighau ila pa nugh malau ee eeza Tarsis. Tauvene ilaagh izila nari le ila peria nugh Yoppa. Ra ighita waaŋ ee tau ighe ila pa nugh Tarsis.
I ighol waaŋ atuya le isov, ra izaa waaŋ tawe, leso ighau pa Yoova gha ila.
Tiraav gha tila, ve Yoova igham yaghur tiina iburig le ipei dibom izaa toman tapiri. Ve rigmon kanaŋ waaŋ imbiriis.

Tauvene roiŋ tiina igham uraata to waaŋ, ve yes eŋaeŋa titaŋ rarai maaron toz toz, leso tiuul zi. Eemon te isaghat le isaghat kat. Tauta tisik yauyauŋ isov ila pa te, leso waaŋ iraurau. Yona, i ikankaan pa pataŋani tau ivot ne. Pasaa, izila waaŋ loolo ta siiŋa we, ve izi igheen le loolo iveegh kat.

Tauvene ŋeer to ghamuuŋ pooz pa waaŋ izila tooni, ve isaav pani ighe: “Wai, ukaria ghenooŋ wa! Uburig ve anam utoov utaŋ rarai maaron tsio ve taghita! Pale irau iuul ghiit ma mako. Pa paita talaleen tane.”

Ra yes uraata to waaŋ tivasavo zi tighe: “Ai! Iit aat tapayooz mbuur, leso taghita sei kat ta imin puughu pa pataŋani tane!” Tauvene tipayooz mbuur le mbuur itotoi ighe Yona ta imin puughu pa pataŋani tane.
Tauvene tighasoni tighe: “Usaav ghazooŋa payei lak! Puughu mindai ta pataŋani tane ivot pait? Ve yo ulaagh pa saa uraat? Yo to saa nugh? Uleep sindei ta ulam?”

Tauvene Yona iyol aliŋazi ighe: “Yau to Hibru. Nabesbees pa Yoova. I Maaron to sambam tau ighur te ve taan. Eemon naghau pani ta nalam.” Tilooŋ saveeŋ tane, le roiŋ tiina igham zi. Tauvene tisaav pani tighe: “Wai, yo ugham sosor tiina kat!
Pale nigham mindai payo, leso te imaat ve taun izi pait?” Pasaa, te isaghat le isaghat kat.
Yona iyol aliŋazi ighe: “Ait ghau ve asik ghau nazila pa te. Leso taun izi. Pasaa, ene yau sosor tsiau, tauta pataŋani tane ivot.”
Yes uraata to waaŋ lolozi pa tisiki izila te rekia mako. Tighe ileep, ve titoov goraaŋ, leso tilooŋ tila pa taan. Tigoor tigoor, eemon tirao mako. Pasaa, nugh isaghat le isaghat kat.

Tauvene tighe tisik Yona izila pa te. Eemon tiroi pa tigham tauvene. Tauta titaŋ rarai Yoova tighe: “O Yoova, isaav ighe nisik ŋeer tane izila te gha imaat, na uvaghamun ghei nimaat sov. Ughit ghei ughe yei nigham sosor sov. Pa yei lolomai pa ravuuŋ ŋeer tane mako. Yo ta ugham gabua tane ivot itaghon taum lolom ve ŋgar tsio.”
Ra tikis Yona ve tisiki izila te, ve rekia mon yaghur tomania dibom isov, ve taun izi.
Yes uraata to waaŋ tighita gabua tana, le tiroi kat pa Yoova. Ve tigham watooŋrau pani, tomania saveeŋ mbuaaŋ ariaaŋa siriv paam.
Ra Yoova imbaaŋ iigh tiina ee ila ve itoon Yona. Tauvene Yona ileep ila iigh aapo loolo irau mboŋ tol.

footnotes.text: Ninive, ene nugh tiina to yes Asiria. Igheen malau kat pa Israel. Yes Israela lolozi pa yes Asiria rigta mako, ve tiroiroi pazi. Pasaa, yes Asiria tirau kat pa ghamuuŋ malmal.
Nugh Tarsis igheen malau kat pa Israel ziige ila pa aaz izila, ve nugh Ninive igheen ila pa aaz izaa. Tauvene tivagharau zi mako. Tigheen soghan soghan kat.
